# PertChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPertChart` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPertChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPertChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPertChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A PERT network

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPertChart> CreatePertChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPertChart> CreatePertChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, PertNodeDesign design, PertChartPaletteKind paletteKind);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPertChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onActivityClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onActivityClick` | _Activity click_ |
| `onActivityDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onActivityDoubleClick` | _Activity double click_ |
| `onActivitySelected` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onActivitySelected` | _Activity selected_ |
| `onActivityDragged` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, double, double)> onActivityDragged` | _Activity dragged_ |
| `onDependencyClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onDependencyClick` | _Dependency click_ |
| `onScheduleComputed` | `std::function<void(double )> onScheduleComputed` | _Schedule computed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `PertNodeDesign`

Visual presentation of an activity node.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Card` | header + code/duration row + dates row |
| `DetailedCard` | Card + responsible row |
| `Compact` | rounded box, name + duration |
| `Circle` | numbered circle, details along connectors (AOA style) |
| `Custom` | rows/cells defined by a PertNodeTemplate |

### enum `PertNodeField`

Value a template cell displays. Numeric CPM fields render as plain trimmed numbers; Duration additionally appends the duration unit.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Literal` | fixed text from PertNodeCell::literal |
| `Name` |  |
| `Code` | activity code (id as fallback) |
| `Duration` | expected duration with unit suffix ("3 days") |
| `DurationValue` | expected duration as a plain number ("3") |
| `EarliestStart` |  |
| `EarliestFinish` |  |
| `LatestStart` |  |
| `LatestFinish` |  |
| `Slack` |  |
| `StartDate` |  |
| `EndDate` |  |
| `Responsible` |  |

### enum `PertCircleLabel`

What the Circle design draws inside the circle.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Code` | activity code inside, name outside above the circle (AOA look) |
| `Name` | activity name inside the circle (single-cell circular node) |

### enum `PertConnectorStyle`

Routing of dependency connectors.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Straight` |  |
| `Orthogonal` |  |
| `Curved` |  |

### enum `PertChartPaletteKind`

Built-in color palettes.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Classic` | white cards, blue headers (project-plan look) |
| `Ocean` | deep blue headers, light blue fills |
| `Vibrant` | saturated blue/orange/green group colors |
| `Pastel` | soft muted fills |
| `Mint` | teal circles / mint accents |
| `Midnight` | dark navy nodes on light background |
| `Dark` | dark background, light nodes |
| `Monochrome` | grayscale |
| `Custom` | palette supplied via SetCustomPalette() |

### struct `PertNodeCell`

One cell of a template row. The displayed text comes from `field` (resolved against the activity and the computed schedule at render time) or from `literal` when field == PertNodeField::Literal.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |

| `field` | `PertNodeField field = PertNodeField::Literal` |  |
| `literal` | `std::string literal` |  |
| `widthWeight` | `double widthWeight = 1.0` | relative width within the row |
| `bold` | `bool bold = false` |  |
| `hasColors` | `bool hasColors = false` | per-cell background/text override |
| `background` | `Color background` |  |
| `textColor` | `Color textColor` |  |
